conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md, effective 2026-01-01), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus members get everything in Standard, plus an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.
I thought it was $149?
The 2026 Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf, effective 2026-01-01) lists Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system, not $149.
